title: NASA mission controller tells of space program honouring 'sponsors' in second-century Latin

tellings.quote: Diana Pulka who talks to this NASA mission controller Tim Taylor and she talks about people in the quote unquote secret space program

plain: People in what is called a secret space programme, a supposed hidden space effort outside the public one, honour unseen "sponsors" in Latin from the second century, according to a NASA mission controller named Timothy Taylor. Michels passes this on second-hand from the scholar Diana Pasulka, who writes about her conversations with Taylor. Told this way, the story hints that such a programme answers to something old and not human.
